title: Stabilizer Induced Module Calculation
body_html:
Stabilizer Induced Module Calculation

The evaluation map identifies the \(K_{M,+}\)-isotypic part of the induced stabilizer representation with \(S(b)^{b_C}\), and the induced module from \(S K_{M,+}\) to \(\Delta^0K_{M,0+}\) is isomorphic to the product Heisenberg-Weil representation \(\kappa_M\).
proof_html:
Extraction

The proof first shows that the desired isotypic subspace is exactly the \(b_C\)-invariant part of the finite oscillator representation. The mixed model of the Weil representation gives the action on the quotient \(b_0\), with the determinant character killed by Lemma 6.10. The remaining induction is computed factor by factor along Yu's construction: each \(\Delta^j\) gives a maximal isotropic subspace, so its Hom space is one-dimensional, and induction over \(j\) proves the required multiplicity-one statement.
